gates.name: Test

gates.name: Inspect tarball
gates.detail: tar -tzf over 323 entries: package/dist/ present; 0 entries under package/src/; 0 tsconfig*.json entries; 0 entries matching .test. — the four assertions the CI step makes.

gates.name: Consumer smoke
gates.detail: consumer-smoke/{node_modules,package-lock.json,dist} cleared, then npm install, npm run install:engine (installed the packed 0.10.0 tarball), npm run build (tsc), npm run smoke (node dist/smoke.js) — exit 0, no diagnostics.

gates.name: Parse-check PowerShell scripts
gates.detail: [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile over every *.ps1 outside node_modules/artifacts — parsed 37 .ps1 files, 0 with errors.

gates.name: Run Pester tests
gates.detail: Invoke-Pester -Path tools -PassThru — Tests Passed: 263, Failed: 0, Skipped: 22, NotRun: 0 (TotalCount 285) in 82.29s.

gates.name: Validate Markdown links, terminology, and generated files
gates.detail: ./build/Test-Documentation.ps1 — 'Human-documentation drift check passed across 18 generated engine page(s), compatibility pointers, and the guide.' and 'Documentation checks passed across 191 Markdown file(s).'

gates.name: Build documentation
gates.reason: ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly could not run: docs.ps1 is not present in this checkout. It is installed by Invoke-SetupDocs rather than committed (CLAUDE.md, Docs Site), so a fresh checkout has no copy. This is the only gate that resolves Docusaurus routes and heading anchors under onBrokenLinks:'throw'; the Verify Documentation Build check on the pull request is where that answer comes from, and it passed there in 1m53s.

gates.name: Build and verify landing page
gates.detail: npm --prefix src/engine run build, then npm --prefix site run check — 'Both built HTML entry points contain their required static metadata, and 3 bundle(s) are free of Node-only runtime references.' plus verify-merge: "Package-backed merge proven: '/', '/roadmap/' and the protected 'docs/' subtree all verified, and the top-level 'docs/' guard rejects a bad landing build."

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: npm --prefix site run merge needs a completed docs build in artifacts/docs, and the gate that produces one (Build documentation) did not run. The artifacts/docs tree present locally is stale — its files date from 08-08, predating this branch — so merging into it would report on an old docs build rather than this tree, which is worse than not running. The corresponding CI job ran this step on the pull request.

gates.name: Test the host
gates.detail: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj — 'Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 12, Skipped: 0, Total: 12, Duration: 897 ms'. NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN is unset locally, but restore was satisfied from the local package cache ('All projects are up-to-date for restore'), so the gate ran for real rather than being skipped.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: The container it probes could not be built locally. docker build with the host-build stage's --mount=type=secret restore failed: "NuGet.targets(782,5): error : Value cannot be null or empty string. (Parameter 'username')" — the build consumes nuget_github_actor/nuget_github_token secrets sourced from REGISTRY_TOKEN in CI, and neither is available in this environment. Docker itself is running; the missing input is the credential, not the daemon.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Builds FROM subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke, the image the step above could not produce, for the same missing REGISTRY_TOKEN-derived build secrets. With no base image there is nothing to corrupt, so the guard could not be exercised.
